page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note on the left at the paragraph beginning "Plumbum nigrum est". Running head at top, page number at top left, catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: Vertitur in plumbum nigrum pollutione & humefactione.
Ex eodem conficitur ablutione & exsiccatione conveniente, seu calcinatione ignea crebra, cum ablutione.

p.i: (Alias etiam per eandem in plumbum nigrum abire potest, praesertim addito stibio.)

main_text.p: Familiare est cum marcasitha stannea, quam bismuthum vocant.
Calcinatione fit album Hispanicum, & vitrescit igne reverberii. Calx ejus.
Reducitur inde in stannum, magno igne, & subitanea inductriaq; fusione.

Plumbum nigrum.Plumbum nigrum est metallum molle, imperfectum, lividius stanno, ex mercurio & sulphure leviter coagulatis, foetidis, impuris, terreis, quodammodo etiam arsenicali spiritu inquinatis, crudioribus tamen & humidioribus, quod lotione, admistione mercurii, & induratione in Plumbum album transit.
Est & acre corrodens; itaq; in examine perfectorum adhibitum, imperfecta quaevis consumit, & secum in favilla scoriasve vertit.
Ob mollitie & leve coagulatione principiorum funditur facilius[?] omni alio metallo.

page.notes: The "Plumbum nigrum." marginal note is set in italic bold and sits in the left margin beside the paragraph it introduces. "Calx ejus" is followed by a printed dot or mark, which is transcribed as a full stop. "facilius" is partly obscured at the line end and is marked [?]. The line "Ob mollitie" has a tilde over the final vowel, reading mollitiē, which is not clearly resolved, so the plain form is given. The first paragraph is taken as continuing from the previous page.
